front: (HL) Factor/remainder theorem for a divisor $ax - b$?
back: Remainder $= P\left(\dfrac ba\right)$; $(ax - b)$ is a factor iff $P\left(\dfrac ba\right) = 0$. E.g. for $2x - 1$ test $P\left(\frac12\right)$.

front: (HL) $(x + 1)$ is a factor of $x^3 + kx^2 - 4$. Find $k$.

back: $P(x) \equiv (x - a)Q(x) + R$, where $Q$ has degree one less than $P$ and $R = P(a)$ is a constant.

front: (HL) How many roots does a degree-$n$ polynomial have?
back: Exactly $n$ in $\mathbb C$ (counting multiplicity). With real coefficients, non-real roots come in conjugate pairs, so odd degree means at least one real root.

front: (HL) What determines the end behaviour of a polynomial graph?
back: The leading term $a_nx^n$: even $n$ — both ends the same way (up if $a_n > 0$); odd $n$ — opposite ends (rising to the right if $a_n > 0$).

front: (HL) Maximum number of turning points of a degree-$n$ polynomial?

back: Positive cubic; crosses at $x = -2$, touches (turning point) at $x = 1$; $y$-intercept 2.
